articles.title: NRI flows into Indian equities dip as compliance rules bite
articles.summary: Recent data reveals a slowdown in investments by Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) into Indian stock markets. This trend occurs as foreign deposits in Indian banks are also a major policy discussion point. For an SSB aspirant, this highlights important economic shifts affecting India's financial sector and national economy.

articles.title: Starmer's cut-price fleet of Navy drones: PM's £14.5billion defence plan 'only half what UK needs to defend itself' with six 'budget warships' to replace destroyers for a new era of warfare
articles.summary: Keir Starmer is set to unveil the UK's long-overdue Defence Investment Plan, featuring a substantial £5 billion allocation for drone 'transformation'. This initiative aims to modernize future defence capabilities. However, the outgoing Prime Minister has reportedly faced criticism regarding the plan's initial funding details, with only £1 billion highlighted, sparking political debate over comprehensive defence spending and strategic priorities.

articles.title: Ajay Devgn's heroine became a household name after her Bollywood debut. Today, she owns a Rs 100 crore home
articles.summary: Actress Madhoo Shah, renowned for her roles in 'Roja' and 'Phool Aur Kaante', recently unveiled her magnificent Malabar Hill residence. This opulent home, valued at an estimated Rs 100 crore, features a palatial design with a soothing beige aesthetic. The grand unveiling provides a glimpse into her substantial real estate holdings in one of Mumbai's most prestigious locations.
